notes.title: Liquid Rhythm Push Control Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Liquid Rhythm Push Control now 20% off + New Improvements in v1.3.4[/h1]

Liquid Rhythm's [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/268125]MIDI Script for Ableton Push[/url] is now available on Steam. Using Max for Live and Ableton Push's "User Mode", WaveDNA's most advanced MIDI script provides control of Liquid Rhythm directly from Push. Users can create and experiment with their beats, and navigate and edit their arrangements without ever having to touch a mouse. This hands free evolution makes music production with Liquid Rhythm even more tactile. 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/268125/]Liquid Rhythm Push Control[/url] is included in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/35349/]Liquid Rhythm Collection[/url] and is available for purchase for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/262610/]Liquid Rhythm[/url], recently updated to include a number of improvements in version 1.3.4. 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/268125]Purchase Liquid Rhythm Push Control[/url] at 20% off until May 12th.

notes.title: Liquid Rhythm Updated to Version 1.3.4
notes.content:
This release features many small improvements and small bugfixes. Exciting additions include (but are not limited) to:
[list]
[*]An advanced [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/268125]MIDI Script for Ableton Push[/url] (available as DLC or part of Liquid Rhythm Collection)
[*]A sleek and stylish [b]Kit Editor[/b]
[/list]

The dev team also added subtle but potent features to some existing features:
[list]
[*]The [url=http://www.wavedna.com/portfolio/ableton-live-clips-plugin/]Ableton Live Clips Plugin[/url]
[*]The [url=http://www.wavedna.com/portfolio/randomizer/]Randomizer[/url]
[/list]

[url=http://www.wavedna.com/liquid-rhythm-and-liquid-rhythm-intro-updated-to-version-1-3-4/]Read about version 1.3.4 in more detail here.[/url]
